info.title: OCLR write API
info.description: Incremental documentation of existing OCLR browser and desktop routes. See write-api-inventory.json for coverage.

localBrowserSession.name: oclr_session
localBrowserSession.description: Session cookie when plain HTTP is allowed locally.

desktopBearer.description: Opaque OCLR desktop access token. Required scope is listed on each operation.

post.summary: Attach a stable replay to a mappool entry
post.description: Requires the edition's replay management permission. Send exactly one part per field, including an empty description if needed. Send expectedVersion as a decimal integer and confirmed as the literal true. The file name must end in .osr, have at most 180 characters, and contain no path separators, control characters, or format characters. A retry with identical bytes returns the existing replay ID, even if the original pool version is stale.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: Must match the configured site origin.

file.description: One stable .osr file up to 8 MiB.

description.description: Plain text without control or format characters.

200.description: The attachment ID, current pool version, and duplicate flag.

400.description: Missing or invalid multipart fields, confirmation, filename, or replay contents.

401.description: An authenticated browser session is required.

403.description: Origin, authentication channel, or edition replay permission rejected.

404.description: The tournament or replay target entry is unavailable.

409.description: The pool changed, the edition is archived, the replay does not match the map, or the entry is full.

413.description: The replay file or complete multipart body exceeds its byte limit.

415.description: Expected multipart/form-data and a supported stable replay version.

503.description: Site configuration or replay storage is unavailable.

delete.description: Requires the edition's replay management permission. Confirm the current pool version. A repeated delete returns removed:false and the current pool version, with no extra audit event.

post.summary: Bind, synchronize, or disconnect an assigned fixture's IRC relay
post.description: Requires a current fixture assignment and an operational edition. Bind checks the authorized osu! identity and may advertise receiptReasons and bpSync. Sync ignores a repeated or older sequence and cannot dispatch the same queued command again. Omit optional capabilities for older clients. Command is null when there is nothing to dispatch. IRC projection and evidence lines reject control and format characters and Unicode line separators.

200.description: Versioned relay receipt. The request ID matches X-Request-Id.

400.description: Missing, malformed, or invalid JSON command.

401.description: Invalid, expired, or revoked desktop access.

403.description: Scope, referee grant, assignment, connection, or IRC identity rejected.

404.description: The fixture or operational edition is unavailable.

409.description: The room binding or operational state has changed.

413.description: The JSON body exceeds the byte limit.

503.description: Service unavailable.

post.summary: Create edition-scoped, read-only streaming access
post.description: Requires a current Streamer grant for the selected edition. The request body origin must be a configured canonical HTTP or HTTPS loopback origin. The issued credential has only streaming:read scope and its lease is bounded by the browser session. Each successful call creates a new token. After an uncertain response, refresh the token list before retrying.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: Must match the configured site origin.

201.description: The token is shown only on creation. The response is never cached.

400.description: Missing, malformed, or invalid JSON command.

401.description: An active browser session is required.

403.description: Origin, authentication channel, or edition Streamer grant rejected.

413.description: The JSON body exceeds the byte limit.

429.description: Rate limit or active token quota reached.

503.description: Site or streaming origin configuration is unavailable or invalid.

delete.summary: Revoke a streaming token owned by the signed-in user
delete.description: Requires an active browser session and token ownership. Repeated revocation returns the same metadata and creates no extra audit event.

parameters.name: Origin

post.summary: Save the signed-in player's own season availability
post.description: Each interval must end after it starts. Overlaps between different availability states are rejected. An omitted status means available. Requires an accepted registration or captain appointment in a published, non-archived edition with a writable player workspace. Send the last observed version as expectedVersion, or 0 for the first write. Reuse requestKey when retrying the same payload after an uncertain outcome.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: Must match the configured site origin.

200.description: The saved version, including for a successful retry.

400.description: Missing, malformed, or invalid JSON command.

401.description: An authenticated browser session is required.

403.description: Origin, authentication channel, or eligibility rejected.

404.description: The workspace is unavailable.

409.description: Read-only workspace, stale data, or a reused request key with a different payload.

413.description: The JSON body exceeds the byte limit.

503.description: Site origin configuration is unavailable or invalid.

post.summary: Save or delete the signed-in player's own practice record
post.description: The mappool entry must be published. expectedContext must match the current chart and mod policy. Deletion returns the same versioned receipt as a save. Requires an accepted registration or captain appointment in a published, non-archived edition with a writable player workspace. Send the last observed version as expectedVersion, or 0 for the first write. Reuse requestKey when retrying the same payload after an uncertain outcome.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: Must match the configured site origin.

comment.description: After trimming surrounding whitespace, the comment may contain up to 2000 UTF-16 code units.

post.summary: Submit or reapply for tournament registration
post.description: Applies as the signed-in player. The saved tournament controls the window, questions, acknowledgments, and eligibility checks. Reapplication requires the prior withdrawal attempt and timestamp. The server checks the configuration revision and applies the transition once. Refresh the dashboard after an uncertain response.

parameters.description: Must match the configured site origin.

409.description: Registration is closed, the application already exists, or a revision changed.

413.description: The JSON body exceeds the byte limit.

503.description: Site, privacy configuration, or eligibility verification is unavailable.

post.summary: Save availability or negotiate a fixture schedule request
post.description: Current players can replace their own availability with up to 40 intervals whose end follows their start. Participating captains can negotiate a new time. Only independent staff with manage_fixtures can approve and update the official time. Fixture and request or availability versions are checked. Repeating the same request key and payload for the same edition and actor returns the original success shape without a second write.

parameters.description: Must match the configured site origin.

post.summary: Change a streaming or commentary assignment
post.description: Omitting task selects the streaming slot. Staff assignment requires a target user or, for commentary only, a list of distinct target users. Commentary cancellation and reconfirmation can target an individual. The server checks role eligibility, ownership, and task and fixture revisions. A matching request key and payload returns replayed=true without writing another event.

patch.summary: Edit a team name and optionally replace or remove its avatar
patch.description: Requires manage_teams and the current setup version. An image file takes precedence over removal. Team capacity is retained. Text-only edits can be submitted as URL-encoded form data.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: Must match the configured site origin.

expectedVersion.description: Setup version converted with Number. An omitted field is treated as zero.

removeAvatar.description: The literal true removes the current avatar unless a replacement file is supplied.

image.description: Optional static JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 5 MiB and 4096 × 4096 pixels. An empty file is ignored.

expectedVersion.description: Setup version converted with Number. An omitted field is treated as zero.

removeAvatar.description: The literal true removes the current avatar unless a replacement file is supplied.

post.summary: Pick an eligible player on the current draft turn
post.description: Requires the active captain or staff authorized to pick on their behalf. The server checks the live session, turn, revision, roster capacity and available pool. A matching idempotency key and payload for the same session and actor returns the existing pick with its current correction state and public version.
